name: Margin Call Response 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the margin call request was sent on a non valuation day or was received after notification time.

NVDA.name: Non Valuation Day
NVDA.definition: Indicates that the margin call request was sent on a non valuation day.

RANT.name: Received After Notification Time
RANT.definition: Indicates that the margin call request was sent after the notification time.
